templates.why_chosen: Star-rated three-zone host-device figure: tan software stack sits above blue gem5 host (CPU/cache/memory simulators) which reaches a pink Accelerator Simulator zone through a dedicated Interconnect Simulator box, with MMIO and DMA arrows individually labeled.
templates.what_to_learn: Give the interconnect itself a named box (Interconnect Simulator) between the two color-coded zones instead of a bare arrow, and label the crossing arrows with the actual interface name (MMIO Read/Write, DMA); but unlike here, draw an arrow, not just vertical adjacency, when one box is said to run inside another.
